events.action: {"message": "Fixed the defect in `tests/kernel/context/src/main.c` where `k_yield_entry()` called `k_sleep(K_MSEC(50))` instead of `k_yield()` after raising its priority above `thread_helper`. Sleeping caused `k_yield_entry` to block for 50ms, allowing the lower-priority `thread_helper` to run and increment `thread_evidence` to 2, and then caused `k_yield_entry` to wake up during `test_timer_interrupts` and fail the assertion checking that `k_yield()` did not yield to a lower-priority thread.\n\nVerified the fix by building and running the `tests/kernel/context` suite on `native_sim`, which passed all test suites (`PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL`).", "kind": "FinishAction"}
